Hypomyelinating CNS disease; developmental dental abnormalities and myopia each occur in 3/8 (~38%), supporting gastrointestinal and ocular involvement.

Sclerosing bone dysplasia with increased bone density; unspecified extraskeletal manifestations do not establish another commonly damaged organ.

Partial 11q duplication typically causes developmental delay/intellectual disability; structural organ abnormalities vary with the duplicated interval and lack established group-wide frequency.
Retinal degeneration and hearing loss jointly define the syndrome.
Isolated developmental eye malformation comprising microphthalmia and coloboma.
Inherited metabolic ataxia per ancestry, with progressive cerebellar disease; optic disc pallor and persistent ocular abnormalities occur in 30-79%. Joint contractures are occasional.
